content: If you choose to participate in this research, you will receive the following benefits: you will be compensated for your work each night for up to a specified number of nights, and you will be provided with either a taxi ride home or accommodation after completing your work at night. Examples of questions to ensure understanding: Can you confirm if you understand the benefits you will receive if you decide to participate in this study? Are you aware that the study will cover your travel expenses and compensate you for your time? Do you know the exact amount you will be reimbursed? Do you have any additional questions about the study? Your right to refuse or withdraw: Participation in this study is entirely voluntary, and you have the right to withdraw at any time. For example: You are not obligated to participate in this research if you do not wish to. You may also stop participating at any point during the study. This decision is entirely yours, and all of your rights will continue to be respected regardless of your choice. Who to contact: You will be provided with the name and contact information of a knowledgeable and accessible individual involved in the study (a local person who can be easily reached). For example: If you have any questions, you may ask them now or at any point during the study. If you prefer to ask questions later, you can contact any of the following individuals: [name, address/telephone number/email]. Ethical approval: This research proposal has been reviewed and approved by [name of the local ethical review board], a committee responsible for ensuring the protection of research participants from harm. For example: If you wish to learn more about the ethical review board, you may contact [name, address, telephone number]. Examples of questions to ensure understanding: Do you understand that you are not required to participate in this study if you do not wish to? Are you aware that you can decline participation by simply saying No? Do you know that you can ask me questions about the study at any time, even after it has started? Are you aware that I have provided you with the contact details of someone who can give you more information about the study? Do you have any questions about any part of the research study? Certificate of consent: This section should be written in the first person and include a clear statement of consent. If the participant is illiterate but provides oral consent, a witness must sign the form. The researcher or the person explaining the informed consent form must also sign each form. The certificate of consent should avoid phrases starting with I understand.... Instead, understanding should be assessed through targeted questions during or after the reading of the information sheet. For example: I, [participant's name], have been clearly informed about the aims of the project titled '[project title]' and agree to participate in the study. I understand that during my participation, mosquitoes may bite me, and they may carry parasites. I am fully aware that I can withdraw my consent and leave the study at any time. Participant name: ___________________________ Participant signature: _______________________ Date: _______________________ (DD/MM/YY) If the participant is illiterate: A literate witness, preferably chosen by the participant and not connected to the research team, must sign the form. The participant should also provide their thumbprint. For example: I have witnessed the accurate reading of the consent form to the potential participant, and the individual has had the opportunity to ask questions. I confirm that the individual has freely given their consent. Print name of witness: _______________________ Thumbprint of participant: ___________________ Signature of witness: ________________________ Date: _______________________ (DD/MM/YY) Statement by the researcher or person obtaining consent: I have accurately read the information sheet to the potential participant and ensured, to the best of my ability, that the participant understands the following: 1. Human landing catch will be conducted between [time] and [time]. 2. The participant has been asked to refrain from smoking and consuming alcohol during the study period. 3. The participant will receive free malaria prophylaxis, screening, and treatment for the duration of the study. 4. The participant will be reimbursed [amount] for the time spent working on the study. I confirm that the participant was given the opportunity to ask questions about the study, and all questions were answered accurately and to the best of my ability. I also confirm that the participant has not been coerced into giving consent and that the consent was given freely and voluntarily. A copy of this informed consent form has been provided to the participant.
